notes.title: Patch - July 6
notes.notes:
In the latest patch, we’ve fixed several bugs and improved visuals.

Changelog:
• Weapons are now positioned correctly relative to controller
• Fixed screen percentage issues
• Improved overall visuals on some levels
• Fixed localization audio
• Improved physics of exploding zombie
• Fixed splash screens
• Fixed engineer’s grenade incorrect radius
• Fixed boards interaction on Waves level
• Fixed ammo drop from robots
• Fixed collisions on some levels

notes.title: Update #2 - New game mode, ammo mechanics and more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32532143/00bcc0d50d184b98533c92c19b7dcb574a7cbfd8.png[/img]

The game got a second update, adding endless waves mode on a new map, ammo drop/pickup mechanics and other various changes and fixes.

Full changelog:
• Added Endless Waves mode on a totally new map. Barricade and survive as long as you can! Enemies will appear from different spot, gradually breaking through the defenses.
• Added ammo drop and pickup mechanics. Use grip buttons to collect ammo or you won’t last long!
• Play area on many maps has been expanded by numerous requests of our players.
• Improved and expanded tutorial to prepare new players for combat!
• Balance improvement on all levels
• Added easter egg in lobby
• Fixed lighting bug on some maps
• Enemies are correctly slowed by Officer’s secondary weapon
• Fixed bug regarding points award for kills
• Improved optimisation on some levels
• Fixed other various bugs

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32532143/590104e31a1c80ae4bb7394e0cb288e8ae0984d6.png[/img]

Big thanks to the community for all the feedback!
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/mundfish] @Mundfish[/url]
Website: [url=http://mundfish.com/] http://mundfish.com[/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/mundfish] Mundish[/url]

P.S. We know that many players are waiting for the story mode levels. We are working hard on them and in the near future we will be able to show them to you! We also want to make the overall controls and game mechanics as interesting as possible, so we hope you’ll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32532143/745296c9c7307e3569405ce64ca41e0082769026.png[/img]

We have fixed some bug, optimized performance and improved graphics.

• Added tutorial for Soldier class
• Class weapons don't have infinite ammo in Rage mode 
• Rebalanced difficulty of each level
• Level 4 boss doesn't shoot at dead players anymore
• Fixed some issues considering revival mechanics 
• Optimized performance of each level
• Improved graphics
• Added camera rotation function
• Fixed bug causing mirror not reflecting boss projectiles on level 4
• Fixed bug considering hamster arcade machine in the lobby
• Fixed bug causing the player to fail to connect to other players in multiplayer

Big thanks to the community for all the feedback!


We welcome all bug reports, performance complaints and suggestions!
